title: Airflow Simulation in Aerospace
summary: Visualizing invisible airflow to design faster, safer aircraft.

scenes.title: Airflow Simulation: See the Unseen
scenes.narration: Airflow simulation, or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), lets engineers visualize and predict how air moves around objects, saving millions in physical testing and optimizing designs.

scenes.title: From Design to Digital Wind
scenes.narration: Engineers input a 3D design, which is then divided into a mesh. A powerful solver applies physics equations to each cell, predicting airflow patterns and forces.

scenes.title: The CFD Pipeline Steps
scenes.narration: The process involves CAD modeling, generating a computational mesh, solving complex fluid equations, and finally, post-processing to visualize results like pressure and velocity.

scenes.title: Optimizing Car Aerodynamics
scenes.narration: In automotive engineering, CFD helps reduce aerodynamic drag by optimizing car body shapes. This improves fuel efficiency by up to 15% and enhances vehicle stability at high speeds.

scenes.title: Impact Across Industries
scenes.narration: Airflow simulation is crucial for diverse fields, from designing efficient HVAC systems in buildings to ensuring safe aircraft performance and even optimizing medical device flows.
